sentences.text: Kueichowlepis is a member of the class Placodermi, an extinct group of armored fish. It belongs to the order Arthrodira and the family Phlyctaeniidae.
The genus Kueichowlepis was described by Pan and Wang in 1975. The only known species of this genus is Kueichowlepis sinensis.
This extinct placoderm fish lived in East Asia during the Devonian period.
